recipes.name: Corn and Black Bean Salad
ingredients_raw: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained

steps.text: In a small bowl, mix together balsamic vinegar, oil, salt, sugar, black pepper, cumin, and chili powder.
In a medium bowl, stir together black beans and corn. Toss with vinegar and oil dressing, and garnish with cilantro. Cover, and refrigerate overnight.

raw_recipe.headline: Corn and Black Bean Salad
raw_recipe.description: A simple cumin dressing is tossed with a salad bowl full of kernel corn and black beans. It’s sensational as is but we think it would be super rolled in a warm tortilla with a dollop of sour cream.

review.reviewBody: The seasonings are right on target. The only thing I feel it needed is a little chopped white, red or green onion. An easy and delicious summer meal idea.

Good flavors! The third time I made it I chose to eliminate the balsamic vinegar, and added chopped green onions, a touch of sea salt and the juice of 3 small limes. It tasted far more "Southwestern" and I ended up preferring it that way.

Good as written, but improved by the addition of a 1/2 onion (finely chopped). I also recommend using 2Tbsp lime juice in place of 2Tbsp of the vinegar - cilantro & lime were made for each other! :-) It is also delicious when served warm - 10min @ 350F in the oven (direct from the refrigerator) was perfect. Thank you for a wonderful salad Jodi T.

Simple, easy, and delicious! This is a very light salad that has a lot of flavor. I used olive oil vs. veg. oil and 2 Tbsp. of cilantro. I added 2 Tbsp. of finely chopped red onion and used an 11 oz. can of no salt added sweet corn. Next time I might added a bit of chopped red pepper for come additional color and crunch. I let it chill for a few of hours before serving and it was even better the next day!

I’m breaking the cardinal rule by making a few changes. I used rice vinegar instead of balsamic, left cilantro out as I don’t like it. I used 2 cans black beans, 1 can corn, a minced jalapeño, chopped red pepper and onion, and minced garlic. I served with corn chip scoops. Rave reviews.

Made it, love it!! Making tonight again, sub lemon juice for half of the balsamic. Can't wait! It's 5-stars AS IS. I like it better with some fine chopped red onion and a squirt of lemon or lime, though. Also, I use an entire 15 oz can of corn when it says to use 8 lol. It's still good that way.
Loved the seasoning for this. I did add 1 avocado, 2 tomatoes, 1/2 an onion, and 1/ 4 cup of quinoa, some extra salt (~1/2 tablespoon) to take it up a notch.
This was delicious and healthy. I used frozen roasted corn and added diced red pepper and diced red pepper. Everyone loved it!

Good, good, good. I made this as a side dish for a burger cookout but my daughter and granddaughter found it before hand. They ate a large portion of it with tortilla chips until I found them and made them get out of it. I made 1 1/2 times the dressing, used two cans of black beans and an 11oz can of shoepeg corn. I also added part of a red pepper diced small. I wanted to use onion but my DD won't eat onion. When I tasted the dressing immediately after mixing I was worried because it tasted grainy. After sitting in the fridge for about 5-6 hours it was perfect. I'm making again for an office function this week and will be adding the onion. I think it will be great with the tortilla chips that have a hint of lime. I'll update my review next week. Thanks for a great recipe.
I added a diced jalapeno and doubled the corn. I also added avocado before i served it. It tasted great! Will definitely make again.

Made this tonight 03-01-2015 turned out really good, I use olive oil instead of vegetable oil cause that is what I had in pantry. I did add 3/4 of yellow sweet onion, a original 10oz can diced tomatoes & green chilies from Hill Country Fare used rice vinegar instead of balsamic cause that's what I had, added all other ingredients to the exact measurements. This will definitely be part of my side dishes, tonight we had chicken lettuce wraps with this on side, and my family just raved. Thank You for this recipe...... From San Antonio Texas O. Santiago
I add red bell pepper & red onion or scallions & fresh garlic👌
I've made this many times - loved by all !
This is a good lunch goto as I try to eat more paleo. The balsamic is a little overpowering, so I substitute avocado oil Italian dressing.
Eating this as I review. OMG!! Amazing!! Followed everything as written but did add red bell pepper and sweet onions. This salad bursts with flavor!! You won’t regret it!
Excellent recipe, I paired this salad with Fish Tacos, was a good match!
Whole family loves it!
I can't call this healthy, there's nothing in it. My wife makes this side dish as a dinner and I have to add rice and creole season. Or I'm starving the rest of the night.
It was too salty and spicy for me. I will make again and see what happened. I'm open for advice and suggestions.
Added chopped scallions!
